mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today is balanced dish. We have clear skies near Harriet Park and a Waning Gibbous moon. If you look up at 5:51 PM, you can catch the ISS passing high in the sky, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward the southeast near Festival Foods.

The City Clerk is reminding residents that candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are available. All four Aldermanic districts are on the ballot and paperwork must be filed by 5 PM on January 5.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, catch live music at Bailey is Run or celebrate 50 years of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, we have The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and more live music at Paddy Mac is.
Looking at the weekly report, on November 6, officers were dispatched to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle. She was eventually arrested for O W I.
Today is Snickers Swirl day at the Verona Culver is. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
